plain_english_policy: The item asks for funding levels without specifying whether higher or lower spending is the intended direction.
evidence_quote: Indicate the funding levels you will support for the following general categories.
review_reason: Item lacks a defensible stable direction as it requests specific funding levels without indicating if an increase (progressive) or decrease (conservative) is preferred. The prompt 'State Budget: Indicate the funding levels...' does not inherently imply a conservative (+1), progressive (-1), or neutral stance on its own.
